title: Arithmetic cofinality commutes with normalized finite-free tensor/limit comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,F of Q_l and an algebra embedding i:E→F. For any scheme W and integer e≥1 let S_H,e be exact arithmetic restriction of constant integral H-module towers to levels e(n+1)-1, and r_H,e:R_H→S_H,e⋙R_H the canonical scalarLimitRestriction derived from ordinary limit.pre [lem-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-reduction]. Let B_i be exact constant scalar extension, T_i its exact derived pointwise tower functor, tau_i the specified scalarLimitTensor, and sigma:S_E,e⋙T_i≅T_i⋙S_F,e the exact localization of the ordinary identity square. For every unbounded derived E-tower K, D(B_i)(r_E,e(K)) followed by tau_i(S_E,e K) followed by R_F(sigma(K)) equals tau_i(K) followed by r_F,e(T_i K). No compact-support or finite-Tor assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Prove the ordinary limit.pre_post square by its cone projections, using preservesLimitIso_hom_π and limit.pre_π: scalar extension of limit.pre followed by the preserved-limit comparison equals the preserved-limit comparison followed by limit.pre of the scalar-extended tower. The ordinary subsequence/tensor square is the identity.

Normalize the three factors of scalarLimitTensor by their universal right-derived units, using rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso_hom_fac, rightDerivedNatTrans_app and mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorIso_hom_fac_app. Normalize scalarLimitRestriction by rightDerivedPullback_fac_app. Naturality moves the localization factors through these maps, and mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_Qh_obj identifies the remaining exact square with localization of the ordinary identity square. The resulting equality is the homotopy-category image of the ordinary square in Step 1.

Restrict to K-injective tower complexes, where the source derived unit is invertible. Cancel its scalar extension. Localization.natTrans_ext for HomotopyCategory.KInjectives.Qh then proves equality of the two natural transformations on the entire derived category. Evaluate at K. The proof needs no cofinality, Roos model, compact-support, or finite-Tor hypothesis.

theorem scalarLimitTensor_restriction (W : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (K : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) W) :
    (baseTensor l E F i W).map ((scalarLimitRestriction l E W e).app K) ≫
        (scalarLimitTensor l E F i W).hom.app ((subsequence l E W e).obj K) ≫
        (scalarLimit l F W).map
          ((letI := (tensor_exact l E F i W).1
            letI := (tensor_exact l E F i W).2
            Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
              (show ordinarySubsequence l E W e ⋙ tensor l E F i W ≅
                tensor l E F i W ⋙ ordinarySubsequence l F W e from Iso.refl _)).hom.app K) =
      (scalarLimitTensor l E F i W).hom.app K ≫
        (scalarLimitRestriction l F W e).app ((T l E F i W).obj K)
